text:
{
  "schema_version": 2,
  "summary": "A literary mystery in which every accurate map purchases knowledge with an intimate memory, forcing a surveyor to decide whether her city should remember a massacre or keep the lie that holds it together. Wonder at the coast's strangeness becomes dread as the cost turns personal, then an earned, conditional hope about chosen remembrance.",
  "nodes": [
    {"id": "literary_mystery", "title": "Literary mystery", "category": "genre", "summary": "The governing genre: an inquiry into a founding crime told through documents, surveys, and intimate consequence rather than action set pieces."},
    {"id": "fantasy", "title": "Fantasy", "category": "genre", "summary": "A secondary genre: the map is a real magical instrument whose rules make memory transfer possible and costly."},
    {"id": "horror", "title": "Horror", "category": "genre", "summary": "A local genre: the intimate erosion of memory produces dread without graphic violence."},
    {"id": "memory_economy", "title": "Memory economy", "category": "engine", "summary": "Every accurate survey transfers a memory out of a person and into the map, so knowledge is always paid for by someone."},
    {"id": "guild_authority", "title": "Guild authority", "category": "thread", "summary": "The Cartographers Guild controls which maps exist and therefore which memories the city can afford to keep."},
    {"id": "founding_archive", "title": "Founding archive", "category": "thread", "summary": "The archive holds surveys that could expose the massacre and the Guild's role in concealing it."},
    {"id": "truth_mercy_dilemma", "title": "Truth and mercy dilemma", "category": "structure", "summary": "The story repeatedly forces a choice between an accurate record that wounds and a merciful omission that protects belonging."},
    {"id": "cost_escalation", "title": "Escalating intimate cost", "category": "structure", "summary": "Each act of discovery costs a more personal memory, moving the mystery from civic history into the surveyor's own identity."},
    {"id": "incomplete_archive", "title": "The incomplete archive", "category": "trope", "summary": "A record is missing, altered, or written by the person investigating it, so the mystery is also a problem of memory."},
    {"id": "implicated_investigator", "title": "The implicated investigator", "category": "trope", "summary": "The surveyor's own work and family history are entangled with the crime, preventing a clean outsider position."},
    {"id": "magical_map", "title": "The magical map", "category": "trope", "summary": "The map is an object with rules: accuracy costs memory, and a perfect map costs a perfect memory."},
    {"id": "intimate_horror", "title": "Intimate horror", "category": "trope", "summary": "The horror is the quiet loss of a shared reference, a name, or a face rather than visible violence."},
    {"id": "wonder_promise", "title": "Wonder promise", "category": "reader_experience", "summary": "The coast and the maps are presented as strange and beautiful, inviting the reader to want the survey to succeed."},
    {"id": "dread_progression", "title": "Dread progression", "category": "reader_experience", "summary": "As the cost becomes personal, the reader's desire for the truth becomes entangled with fear of what it will erase."},
    {"id": "earned_hope", "title": "Earned hope", "category": "reader_experience", "summary": "Hope is available only through a chosen, partial remembrance that acknowledges loss rather than denying it."},
    {"id": "luminous_cartography", "title": "Luminous cartography", "category": "aesthetic", "summary": "Precise, sensory map-making imagery makes the coast feel desirable and the erasures feel like vandalism."},
    {"id": "memory_ethics", "title": "Ethics of memory", "category": "theme", "summary": "The story asks what a community owes its dead, its living, and its comforting stories."},
    {"id": "complicity", "title": "Complicity", "category": "theme", "summary": "Knowing is not innocence: the surveyor's craft is part of the system that erases."}
  ],
  "links": [
    {"id": "mystery_enables_fantasy", "source": "literary_mystery", "target": "fantasy", "function": "turns the magical map into evidence and a source of clues"},
    {"id": "fantasy_constrains_mystery", "source": "fantasy", "target": "literary_mystery", "function": "limits solutions to the map's memory rules"},
    {"id": "horror_pressures_mystery", "source": "horror", "target": "literary_mystery", "function": "makes each answer intimate and costly"},
    {"id": "engine_drives_cost", "source": "memory_economy", "target": "cost_escalation", "function": "turns every discovery into a personal loss"},
    {"id": "engine_feeds_archive", "source": "memory_economy", "target": "founding_archive", "function": "explains how the city's records were made and hidden"},
    {"id": "guild_controls_archive", "source": "guild_authority", "target": "founding_archive", "function": "decides which surveys survive"},
    {"id": "archive_raises_dilemma", "source": "founding_archive", "target": "truth_mercy_dilemma", "function": "supplies the evidence that makes the choice unavoidable"},
    {"id": "cost_raises_dilemma", "source": "cost_escalation", "target": "truth_mercy_dilemma", "function": "makes truth personally expensive"},
    {"id": "dilemma_produces_hope", "source": "truth_mercy_dilemma", "target": "earned_hope", "function": "makes hope conditional on a chosen remembrance"},
    {"id": "incomplete_archive_hides", "source": "incomplete_archive", "target": "founding_archive", "function": "keeps the historical record incomplete"},
    {"id": "implicated_investigator_pressures", "source": "implicated_investigator", "target": "cost_escalation", "function": "makes the investigation threaten the surveyor's own past"},
    {"id": "magical_map_instantiates", "source": "magical_map", "target": "memory_economy", "function": "gives the memory economy a concrete instrument"},
    {"id": "intimate_horror_renders", "source": "intimate_horror", "target": "dread_progression", "function": "renders loss without graphic violence"},
    {"id": "wonder_grounds", "source": "wonder_promise", "target": "luminous_cartography", "function": "makes the coast desirable before its cost is clear"},
    {"id": "dread_pays", "source": "dread_progression", "target": "cost_escalation", "function": "tracks the escalation of intimate loss"},
    {"id": "ethics_questions", "source": "memory_ethics", "target": "truth_mercy_dilemma", "function": "frames the choice as an ethical question"},
    {"id": "complicity_questions", "source": "complicity", "target": "implicated_investigator", "function": "makes the investigator part of the system she exposes"},
    {"id": "hope_answers", "source": "earned_hope", "target": "memory_ethics", "function": "offers a partial answer without resolving the theme"}
  ],
  "emotion_targets": [
    {"id": "wonder", "emotion": "joy", "role": "primary", "intended_effect": "Wonder at the coast's strange maps and the beauty of accurate knowledge.", "eliciting_condition": "A survey reveals a coastline more intricate than the city believed.", "aesthetic_strategy": "Luminous cartographic detail and patient description.", "provenance": "author_declared"},
    {"id": "dread", "emotion": "fear", "role": "supporting", "intended_effect": "Mounting dread as each accurate map costs an intimate memory.", "eliciting_condition": "A familiar person or place becomes slightly less remembered.", "aesthetic_strategy": "Quiet omissions and repeated details that no longer match.", "provenance": "author_declared"},
    {"id": "hope", "emotion": "joy", "role": "supporting", "intended_effect": "Conditional hope that chosen, partial remembrance can honor both truth and belonging.", "eliciting_condition": "A deliberate record preserves what matters without claiming completeness.", "aesthetic_strategy": "Warm, modest images of repair.", "provenance": "author_declared"},
    {"id": "grief", "emotion": "sadness", "role": "supporting", "intended_effect": "Grief for memories that cannot be recovered.", "eliciting_condition": "A loss is acknowledged rather than reversed.", "aesthetic_strategy": "Restrained elegy and concrete absence.", "provenance": "agent_proposed"},
    {"id": "anger", "emotion": "anger", "role": "contrasting", "intended_effect": "Anger at the Guild's paternalism and at the city's convenience.", "eliciting_condition": "A decision is made for others in the name of mercy.", "aesthetic_strategy": "Dry documentary contrast with the cost borne by individuals.", "provenance": "agent_proposed"},
    {"id": "revelation_surprise", "emotion": "surprise", "role": "local", "intended_effect": "Surprise when a familiar record turns out to be a chosen omission.", "eliciting_condition": "An archive fragment contradicts the official history.", "aesthetic_strategy": "Delayed disclosure and material evidence.", "provenance": "agent_proposed"}
  ],
  "complex_emotions": [
    {"id": "uneasy_wonder", "title": "Uneasy wonder", "basic_emotions": ["joy", "fear"], "context": "The coast is beautiful and the beauty is purchased with loss."},
    {"id": "hope_through_grief", "title": "Hope through grief", "basic_emotions": ["joy", "sadness"], "context": "A partial record makes room for both mourning and continuing life."},
    {"id": "moral_dread", "title": "Moral dread", "basic_emotions": ["fear", "anger"], "context": "The reader recognizes that good intentions are doing harm."}
  ],
  "genre_contracts": [
    {"genre_node_id": "literary_mystery", "role": "governing", "emotion_target_ids": ["wonder", "dread", "grief"], "complex_emotion_ids": ["uneasy_wonder", "hope_through_grief"], "trope_functions": ["The incomplete archive", "The implicated investigator"], "narrative_engine": "Each answer changes what the surveyor must conceal or reveal, and the archive answers only through records that were themselves made by erasure.", "structural_pattern": "Question, partial answer, intimate cost, deeper question, final choice.", "aesthetic_strategies": ["Luminous cartography", "Quiet omission"], "payoff_expectations": ["The city's founding story is revealed as a chosen record, not a neutral fact."]},
    {"genre_node_id": "fantasy", "role": "supporting", "emotion_target_ids": ["wonder", "revelation_surprise"], "complex_emotion_ids": ["uneasy_wonder"], "trope_functions": ["The magical map"], "narrative_engine": "The map's rules generate new uses, limits, and costs for every act of knowledge.", "structural_pattern": "Rule discovery, application, unintended cost, revised rule.", "aesthetic_strategies": ["Precise magical rules rendered as craft."], "payoff_expectations": ["The reader understands the map's cost without needing a system treatise."]},
    {"genre_node_id": "horror", "role": "tertiary", "emotion_target_ids": ["dread", "grief"], "complex_emotion_ids": ["moral_dread"], "trope_functions": ["Intimate horror", "The cost of knowledge"], "narrative_engine": "Every act of knowledge produces an intimate loss that the story refuses to make spectacular.", "structural_pattern": "Ordinary moment, small absence, dawning recognition, restrained consequence.", "aesthetic_strategies": ["Intimate sensory detail with no graphic violence."], "payoff_expectations": ["Dread accumulates through recognition rather than shock."]}
  ],
  "genre_interactions": [
    {"id": "mystery_enables_fantasy", "source_genre_id": "literary_mystery", "target_genre_id": "fantasy", "kind": "enables", "mechanism": "The inquiry gives the magical map a use as evidence, so its rules matter to the solution.", "risk": "The fantasy could become a puzzle device that drains the human cost."},
    {"id": "fantasy_constrains_mystery", "source_genre_id": "fantasy", "target_genre_id": "literary_mystery", "kind": "constrains", "mechanism": "Every solution must obey the map's memory rules, preventing arbitrary detective work.", "risk": "Too many rules could turn the mystery into a manual."},
    {"id": "horror_pressures_mystery", "source_genre_id": "horror", "target_genre_id": "literary_mystery", "kind": "creates_tension", "mechanism": "The horror keeps the investigation from becoming a clean triumph.", "risk": "The dread could overpower the pleasure of discovery."},
    {"id": "mystery_horror_converge", "source_genre_id": "literary_mystery", "target_genre_id": "horror", "kind": "converges", "mechanism": "The final choice is both a solution and an act of intimate loss.", "risk": "The convergence could feel like two endings rather than one."}
  ],
  "phases": [
    {"id": "strange_coast", "title": "Strange coast", "order": 0, "genres": [{"genre": "literary_mystery", "role": "governing"}, {"genre": "fantasy", "role": "supporting"}, {"genre": "horror", "role": "background"}], "genre_activations": [{"genre_node_id": "literary_mystery", "basic_emotions": ["joy", "surprise"], "trope_functions": ["The incomplete archive"], "structural_function": "Establish the inquiry and the city's dependence on accurate maps."}, {"genre_node_id": "fantasy", "basic_emotions": ["joy", "surprise"], "trope_functions": ["The magical map"], "structural_function": "Establish the map's rules through use, not exposition."}, {"genre_node_id": "horror", "basic_emotions": ["fear"], "trope_functions": ["Intimate horror"], "structural_function": "Seed unease without unveiling the cost."}], "reader_experience": "Wonder and curiosity; the reader wants the survey to succeed.", "aesthetic": "Luminous cartography.", "narrative_function": "Establish wonder and the map's promise.", "transition": "A first memory is found missing.", "parallel_with": []},
    {"id": "first_erasure", "title": "First erasure", "order": 1, "genres": [{"genre": "literary_mystery", "role": "governing"}, {"genre": "fantasy", "role": "supporting"}, {"genre": "horror", "role": "locally_dominant"}], "genre_activations": [{"genre_node_id": "literary_mystery", "basic_emotions": ["fear", "sadness"], "trope_functions": ["The implicated investigator"], "structural_function": "Make the investigation personal."}, {"genre_node_id": "fantasy", "basic_emotions": ["fear"], "trope_functions": ["The magical map"], "structural_function": "Show a concrete memory cost."}, {"genre_node_id": "horror", "basic_emotions": ["fear", "sadness"], "trope_functions": ["Intimate horror"], "structural_function": "Turn the cost intimate."}], "reader_experience": "Dread becomes personal.", "aesthetic": "Quiet omission and intimate detail.", "narrative_function": "Turn wonder into dread by making the cost personal.", "transition": "The missing memory points to the founding archive.", "parallel_with": []},
    {"id": "archive_revelation", "title": "Archive revelation", "order": 2, "genres": [{"genre": "literary_mystery", "role": "governing"}, {"genre": "fantasy", "role": "supporting"}, {"genre": "horror", "role": "supporting"}], "genre_activations": [{"genre_node_id": "literary_mystery", "basic_emotions": ["surprise", "anger"], "trope_functions": ["The incomplete archive", "The implicated investigator"], "structural_function": "Reveal the massacre and the Guild's complicity."}, {"genre_node_id": "fantasy", "basic_emotions": ["surprise"], "trope_functions": ["The magical map"], "structural_function": "Reveal the scale of what a perfect map would erase."}, {"genre_node_id": "horror", "basic_emotions": ["fear", "anger"], "trope_functions": ["The cost of knowledge"], "structural_function": "Make the historical crime present through memory loss."}], "reader_experience": "Moral dread and anger; the truth is larger than the surveyor.", "aesthetic": "Archive fragments, gaps, and contradictory records.", "narrative_function": "Reveal the founding crime and the Guild's complicity.", "transition": "A perfect map becomes possible, and with it a city-wide erasure.", "parallel_with": []},
    {"id": "choice_of_maps", "title": "Choice of maps", "order": 3, "genres": [{"genre": "literary_mystery", "role": "governing"}, {"genre": "fantasy", "role": "supporting"}, {"genre": "horror", "role": "supporting"}], "genre_activations": [{"genre_node_id": "literary_mystery", "basic_emotions": ["joy", "sadness"], "trope_functions": ["The implicated investigator", "The incomplete archive"], "structural_function": "Force the surveyor to choose what record to leave."}, {"genre_node_id": "fantasy", "basic_emotions": ["joy", "fear"], "trope_functions": ["The magical map"], "structural_function": "Make the map's final use a moral act."}, {"genre_node_id": "horror", "basic_emotions": ["fear", "sadness"], "trope_functions": ["Intimate horror"], "structural_function": "Let the cost be acknowledged rather than reversed."}], "reader_experience": "Earned, conditional hope through grief.", "aesthetic": "Modest repair; a record that admits its gaps.", "narrative_function": "Resolve the choice through a partial, chosen remembrance.", "transition": "The city keeps a record that is honest about what it cannot restore.", "parallel_with": []}
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "Whose memory should the final record preserve, and who decides?",
    "Is the Guild's lie ever defensible as mercy, or only as control?",
    "Should the city's founding crime be public knowledge or a private grief?",
    "How much of the surveyor's own past may the story erase before she is no longer the same person?"
  ]
}
